{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA rows
df_clean = df[~(df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)].copy()

# Filter out refunded orders — only keep 'completed' status
df_completed = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed'].copy()

# Compute total revenue by channel for completed orders
total_revenue_by_channel = df_completed.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Find the channel with the highest total revenue
best_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
max_revenue = total_revenue_by_channel.max()

print(total_revenue_by_channel)
print(f"Channel with highest total revenue (completed only): {best_channel} (${max_revenue:,.2f})")"}
